Main text in one column with headings and verse stanzas; two short verse stanzas in italic set in parallel columns below the text; a heading and a further verse couplet near the foot; a catchword-like mark "DE" at lower right.

main_text.p: preces intende, & pio juvamine maculas dique. In via nos adjuva, colloca in patria, & redde quae speramus bona. Amen.
main_text.head: DE S. LIBERIO, CONTRA CALCULUM.
main_text.p: Deus, qui beatum Liberium, Pontificem tuum, innumeris gloriosum miraculis, speciali in medendis arenarum & calculi passionibus privilegio decoratsi, praesta quaesumus, ut ipsius meritis & intercessione, ab his aliisque malis eruti, gaudiis perfrui merearmur aeternis.
main_text.head: DE ABBATIBUS.
main_text.p: Intercessio nos, quaesumus Domine, beati N. Abbatis commendet, ut, quod nostris meritis non valemus, ejus patrocinio assequamur.
main_text.l: Da supplicanti coetui, | Proinde te, piissime,
Obtentu hujus optimi, | Precamur omnes supplices,
Remissionem criminum, | Ut hujus almi gratia
Rupendo nexu vinculi, &c. | Nobis remittas debita.
main_text.head: DE S. GOTHARDO, ABBATE Hirsfeldensi. 26. Martii.
main_text.l: Opem nobis praesul bone | Et nos salva in agone
Fer in nostris angustiis, | Ab aeternis supplicus.

page.notes: Verse set in italic in two parallel columns; the couplet lines are reconstructed by column. Final lines near the foot partly illegible; "Ab aeternis supplicus" and "26" in the Gothard heading are uncertain. Ornamental initials and worn stains omitted.
